subject: APAC morning demo request — same-day availability?
messages:
From: Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@fintech-eu.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: itops@fintech-eu.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 06:20:00 +0200
Subject: Quick - can we do a demo tomorrow morning (APAC)?

Hi Aditya,

Apologies for the short notice — we have an internal stakeholder who will be free tomorrow morning SGT and would like a product walkthrough. Is there any chance Redwood can do a short, focused demo at 09:00 SGT on Friday (2026-07-03)? That would be 01:00 UTC on the 3rd, I believe.

Important context:
- We want to validate latency and model-routing behavior from our Singapore region.
- Security team attached a quick checklist (SOC2 summary) and a couple of initial questions.

If the exact slot isn't possible, what are the earliest APAC-friendly windows you can offer? We can be flexible but prefer Friday morning SGT.

Thanks — this is time-sensitive as execs want to see live routing.

Best,
Sophie Laurent
Program Lead, Integrations — Fintech EU GmbH
[Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf]
[Attachment: initial-questions.docx]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@fintech-eu.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick - can we do a demo tomorrow morning (APAC)?

Hi Sophie — thanks for the note and for sending the checklist. Appreciate the urgency.

Short answer: we can do a focused session, but the requested time (09:00 SGT / Friday) is outside standard hours for our APAC-hosted engineering reps — it falls late night for our US-based demo team. I want to avoid a degraded experience, so two quick options: 

1) We can run a compact 30-minute demo at 09:00 SGT Friday (your preferred time) as an exception — I will escalate to my manager for authorization and ask our on-call engineer to join remotely. That would likely be recorded but may have limited live troubleshooting if anything unexpected happens.

2) Alternatively, we can do 06:00 SGT (earlier) or 11:00 SGT (later) on Friday when APAC engineering is available during business hours — both would give us the full team.

Notes on timezone/DST: our calendar currently reflects US DST (PDT), so I double-checked conversions. 09:00 SGT on Fri, 2026-07-03 is 18:00 PDT on Thu, 2026-07-02 for my manager, and 02:00 PDT for one of our APAC engineers if they join from a different location — that’s why I want approval before committing.

Can you confirm whether the session needs live infrastructure troubleshooting (we'd want engineering on the call) or if a product walkthrough with recorded performance examples suffices? If it’s the latter we can safely run at 09:00 SGT.

Laura — looping you in because Sophie is asking for a same-day APAC slot that requires an after-hours exception. Can you advise if we should approve the 09:00 SGT exception for this account (DEAL-8472)?

If approved I'll send a calendar invite and a brief run-of-show.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0112
[Calendar stub will follow]

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick - can we do a demo tomorrow morning (APAC)?

Aditya — thanks for the heads up. Approve one-off after-hours coverage for this demo. Conditions:

- Keep it to 30 minutes and record the session.
- Have a CS engineer (one of Marissa's team) on standby rather than full engineering unless the customer explicitly requests live infra debugging.
- Offer a single $500 service credit for the late-hour exception if the customer requests an on-call engineer.

Aditya, please confirm the run-of-show and include the credit language in the invite if you use it. Also, please add Marissa Cole (cc'd in the calendar invite) to standby. I'll authorize this as an exception for DEAL-8472.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference
[Sent from mobile]

From: Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@fintech-eu.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: itops@fintech-eu.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 22:15:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Quick - can we do a demo tomorrow morning (APAC)?

Thanks Aditya — that works for us. We only need a product walkthrough and to see routing/latency from Singapore; no live infra debugging required. 30 minutes is perfect.

Please go ahead and book 09:00 SGT / Fri 2026-07-03 and include the recording. If you could add a short note about the DST conversions for internal attendees that would help avoid confusion on our calendar.

Appreciate the flexibility. Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Sophie
